debian13.comment: Debian 13 genericcloud, pinned 2026-11-21 (release 2026-11-11, past the 6-day cooldown). Debian does not sign cloud images: the SHA-512 is copied from SHA512SUMS on cloud.debian.org (HTTPS) and checked by scripts/fetch_image.py. Never change an image in place: add a new entry (ADR-0033).
